notes: WArmy 0.4.3: the security level picked in the chat bar now reaches the authorization engine (full authorization no longer prompts for ordinary task files); command execution restores standard system environment variables on machines where they are missing so dotnet/NuGet builds work again; PowerShell-syntax commands are no longer misrouted through cmd; the continue/retry button is anchored to the message where the latest interruption happened; the running small-text bar shows in independent windows and no longer double-prints the ellipsis; all 1000 Chinese busy phrases and 27 languages of status lines were rewritten as fluent complete sentences; the strict-language constraint now really applies (including chain-of-thought and tool arguments) and is also injected for subagent tasks; authorization cards show what a command is for and collapse the full command text; model capability detection fixes (embed context cap, bare bark TTS).
